vocabulary.meaning_en: to make a different decision from before
vocabulary.example: I've changed my mind - I'll take the job after all.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to think carefully for a long time
vocabulary.example: I've done a lot of thinking about my career.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to understand something you did not understand before
vocabulary.example: I didn't realise how busy you were.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to feel sad because someone or something is not there
to say no to an offer or a person

vocabulary.example: Anna must convince Tom to stay.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the place at an airport where you give your bags and get your boarding pass
vocabulary.example: The check-in desk for Sydney is number 47.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to get on a plane, train or ship
vocabulary.example: Passengers can now board the plane.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the more expensive seats on a plane, better than economy
the cheapest seats on a plane
a person travelling in a plane, train, bus or car
vocabulary.example: The passengers waited at the gate.
Are you available for a meeting tomorrow?
We arrived in time for the meeting.
At last, the report is finished!

vocabulary.meaning_en: finally, after many changes or problems
vocabulary.example: In the end, we chose the cheaper supplier.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make someone experience something difficult

fine_lines.title: miss: feel sad vs fail to catch
fine_lines.explanation_ar: miss لها معنيان شائعان: «يفتقد» شخصًا غائبًا (I miss you)، و«يفوته» شيء مثل الطائرة أو الحافلة (I missed my flight). آنا لم ترد أن يفوتها توم قبل صعوده الطائرة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Miss has two common meanings: feel sad that someone is not there (We miss you), and fail to catch or be in time for something (I missed my flight).

examples.sentence: The whole office misses our old manager.
Hurry, or we'll miss the train!

fine_lines.title: in time vs on time
fine_lines.explanation_ar: on time: في الموعد المحدد تمامًا. in time: مبكرًا بما يكفي قبل فوات الأوان. هل ستصل آنا in time قبل صعود توم الطائرة؟
fine_lines.explanation_en: On time = at the planned time, not late. In time = early enough, before it is too late. Will Anna get there in time, before Tom boards?

examples.sentence: The flight left on time at 9:00.
We got to the airport just in time.

expressions.phrase: I've been doing a lot of thinking.
expressions.meaning_en: I have thought carefully for some time (and maybe changed my opinion).
expressions.example: I've been doing a lot of thinking about your idea, and I like it now.

expressions.phrase: I didn't realise how much I missed you until you had gone.
expressions.meaning_ar: لم أدرك كم افتقدتك إلا بعد أن رحلت.
expressions.meaning_en: I understood your value only after you left.
expressions.example: Our team didn't realise how much we missed you until you had gone.
I said no to the offer yesterday, but I've changed my mind.
Please don't go - we need you on this project.

expressions.meaning_en: Asking for a reason before agreeing.
expressions.example: You want me to stay late again? Why should I?

expressions.phrase: If you put it like that, then yes.
expressions.meaning_ar: إذا وضعت الأمر بهذه الطريقة، فنعم.
expressions.example: A pay rise and a new office? If you put it like that, then yes.

expressions.phrase: Do you know where the check-in desks for flights to Sydney are?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تعرف أين مكاتب تسجيل الوصول للرحلات المتجهة إلى سيدني؟
expressions.meaning_en: A polite question at an airport.
expressions.example: Excuse me, do you know where the check-in desks for flights to Dubai are?

grammar.title: Past perfect with until: …until you had gone
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم الماضي التام had + التصريف الثالث لحدث وقع قبل حدث آخر في الماضي. في الجملة I didn't realise… until you had gone: الرحيل حدث أولًا ثم جاء الإدراك.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the past perfect (had + past participle) for the earlier of two past events. In 'I didn't realise... until you had gone', leaving happened first, then the realising.
examples: I didn't understand the problem until I had read the report.
We didn't start until everyone had arrived.
She didn't relax until she had finished the project.

grammar.title: Embedded questions: I didn't realise how much…
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما يأتي سؤال داخل جملة، لا نقلب الترتيب: نقول how much I missed you وليس how much did I miss you. وكذلك: Do you know where the desks are? وليس where are the desks.
grammar.explanation_en: When a question is inside a sentence, use normal word order (subject + verb): 'how much I missed you', not 'how much did I miss you'; 'Do you know where the desks are?', not 'where are the desks'.
examples: I didn't realise how much work it was.
Do you know where the meeting room is?
Can you tell me what time the flight leaves?

grammar.title: Present perfect for a new decision: I've changed my mind
grammar.explanation_ar: لنعلن تغيّرًا في الرأي نتيجته واضحة الآن نستخدم المضارع التام: I've changed my mind. وللتفكير المستمر حتى الآن: I've been doing a lot of thinking.
grammar.explanation_en: To announce a change with a result now, use the present perfect: I've changed my mind. For thinking that went on until now: I've been doing a lot of thinking.
examples: I've changed my mind about the trip.
I've been thinking about your offer.

questions.question: 'I've changed my mind' means…
questions.explanation_ar: change your mind أي تغيير القرار.
questions.explanation_en: It means my decision is different now.

questions.question: I didn't realise how much I missed you until you had ___.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي التام: had + التصريف الثالث gone.

questions.question: What class does Tom claim he always flies in?
questions.explanation_ar: قال توم إنه يطير دائمًا بدرجة رجال الأعمال.
questions.explanation_en: Tom says he always flies business class.

questions.question: Which is correct?
choices: Do you know where are the check-in desks?
Do you know where the check-in desks are?
Do you know where is the check-in desks?
Do you know the check-in desks where are?
questions.explanation_ar: في السؤال الضمني يكون الترتيب: فاعل + فعل.

questions.question: Where do you give your bags and get your boarding pass at an airport?
'I've been doing a lot of thinking' means…
choices: I have thought carefully for some time
questions.explanation_ar: تعني أنني كنت أفكّر كثيرًا حتى الآن.
questions.explanation_en: It means I have thought carefully for some time.

questions.question: Hurry, or we'll ___ the flight!
questions.explanation_en: 'Miss' here means not be in time for.

questions.question: Anna hopes to get to the airport ___, before Tom boards the plane.
questions.explanation_ar: in time أي مبكرًا بما يكفي قبل فوات الأوان.

questions.question: After a long wait: '___, the report is finished!'
questions.explanation_ar: at last تعني أخيرًا بعد انتظار طويل.
questions.explanation_en: 'At last' means finally, after a long time.
